description: Maps alert categories to kill-chain stages and defines when alerts escalate to incidents.

single_alert_incident.description: A single alert opens an incident when it is critical; a potential unknown attack needs either very high risk or repeated occurrences (corroboration) to avoid one incident per stray anomaly.

multi_stage_chain.description: Alerts from the same actor (or a host that was itself a victim) spanning >= min_stages distinct stages inside the correlation window form an attack chain.
